scope: source/dependency inventory and fixed future isolated synthetic loss/gradient/AdamW/checkpoint tests only; no pointer tracking and no full SmallForecaster or real training

numerical_contract.gradients_before_and_after_clip: gradient including global relative_L2 and zero-reference rule
numerical_contract.same_Rust_resume: same_backend_resume byte-exact; does not replace cross-language tolerances

toy_per_step_gates.all_steps_gradient: gradient including global relative_L2 and zero norm rule

preflight.before_acceptance: preserve original snapshots; propose an isolated scratch-copy offline lock synchronization, verify package/version/active features unchanged except required root-edge removal; no automatic restoration of old experimental features; only after source/lock consistency passes add an explicit synthetic test target
preflight.planned_feature: training-tests=[] used only to gate the artificial harness, not to widen backend features
preflight.planned_test_command: cargo test --locked --offline -p banto-ai --features training-tests --test r2p_synthetic; avoid --all-targets historical examples

planned_modules: feature-gated train tensor loss and named parameter/gradient state
compatible named AdamW built from Burn tensor operations
implementation_boundary.native_optimizer_selection: one compatible implementation from pinned Torch operation semantics, not a sweep over builtin alternatives
implementation_boundary.autodiff: Tensor.autodiff().require_grad on every trainable leaf; constants/buffers untracked; rebuild fresh leaf graph per update; missing gradients are errors
implementation_boundary.forward_readback: tensor outputs must reach loss/backward without conversion to host vectors; host readback only at logging/checkpoint/comparison boundaries
implementation_boundary.full_forecaster_synthetic_connection: separate later specification after these isolated gates; not implied by this v1

checkpoint.format: deterministic JSON manifest, little-endian float32 tensor payload, hashes and exclusive commit marker last
required: ordered named parameter shapes/values and roles
named first/second moments with exact complete parameter set
immutable recipe/fixture/schedule hashes and next position
checkpoint.writer: write payload and fsync, write verified manifest and fsync, write exclusive commit marker last and fsync; no replacement/activation of a previous root; incomplete artifacts retained but never accepted
checkpoint.restore: check marker/schema/hashes/names/dtypes/shapes/bounds/completeness/finite values/nonnegative v/integers/schedule/recipe compatibility before creating mutable training state; no fallback zero state; reconstruct new autodiff leaves; resume at next position4 after step4
checkpoint.cancel: at update boundary only, finish and commit step4 then stop before5; do not serialize a partial update or reset moments
checkpoint.same_backend_exact: parameters/moments/counters/schedule_next/probe outputs match uninterrupted run; output paths and journal metadata do not alter logical state

sequence: finish/pin inventory and this specification without numerical execution
resolve the recorded manifest/lock preflight in a separately recorded minimal change
generate and close the one Python reference plus independent expectations
implement one isolated Rust consumer/optimizer/checkpoint harness
one finite numerical/rejection/resume run per fixed case; preserve any failure and stop dependent work
stops: unexpected None gradient or nonfinite state
any real-data or suspended pointer access

limits.monitoring: include compiler/linker/process-group descendants; no hard OS cap claim
